pages.transcription:
Therezopolis, 6.10.40
Dear Hanna and Manfred,
I write rather in a hurry for
we have just arrived here for a weeks' rest, and Stefan's
editor and his wife who brought us here in their car,
are still with us and waiting to take us round and
show us the town or village, whatever it is. I hope that
you are all well, that Manfred has not too much work
and was able to take a few days rest in Bath with
you, Hanna. How I wish we could be there together, soon.
From Eva I only had a cable announcing her arrival,
and a letter from Stefan's brother that Salmon's post-
poned their visit to New Rochell twice because Eva was
invited. I suppose that Eva has a very good time,
and probably they sent her letter to my by ordinary
mail so that it will arrive here only in about a fortnight
just before we leave for Argentine.
Kindest regards and kisses,
Lotte.
Dear H. a. M. we are looking every days through all newspapers
for good news and follow all the events - we hope the best for you. We regret
very much to leave Brazil for here true the 26. October - we has here an ex-
cellent time. We have seen the most wonderful houses, my publisher brings us
everywhere we like in his car, our friend the Viscount Arcuri de arrange all
social thing for us in a splendid way, the Ambassador of Cuba sends me
nearly every week a box of Havannahs and on every corner are coffeehouses.
We live very dearly here and see a lot - all would be perfect if how
the anxious thoughts about you. I suppose we will leave our Chile and
Venezuela, I am not willing to travel too much as I have no heart to
work and one has to do his work even in these times. I hear that
Robert Hermann is back again, I wish I knew his adress as I would
like to let him know that we do not forget him. Love Stefan
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf rosa Papier. Die erste Hälfte ist von Lotte Zweig, die zweite Hälfte (ab 'Dear H. a. M.') ist von Stefan Zweig geschrieben. Die Tinte ist violett.
Farbskala/Grauskala fuer Archivierung. Das Dokument liegt unter der Skala.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar. Die Handschrift von Lotte und Stefan Zweig ist klar erkennbar. Einige kleine orthographische Eigenheiten des Autors wurden originalgetreu übernommen.
